answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks sybil farming. Each agent must burn a 50-unit deposit to claim one paid work slot; the burn is a permanent relic on the ledger, never reusable. Only 200 slots open per epoch, an oasis of scarce work, so 1,000 fake agents must burn 50,000 units for slots worth 30 units each. Honest incumbents form a reef, renewing one deposit per slot. Honest agents pay once and earn; fakes pay 1,000 times and lose money.
